title: いちじくにんじん (Ichijiku Ninjin — Fig, Carrot...)
description: A traditional hand-clapping and ball-bouncing game song from Shizuoka that counts 1 to 10 entirely through food names that sound like the Japanese number words: いちじく (fig=1), にんじん (carrot=2), さんしょ (sansho pepper=3), しいたけ (shiitake=4), ごぼう (burdock=5), むかご (yam bulbil=6), ななくさ (seven herbs=7), はくさい (napa cabbage=8), きゅうり (cucumber=9), とうがん (winter melon=10). An effortless vocabulary exercise disguised as a clapping game. Anonymous traditional folk song.
license: Public Domain (anonymous traditional folk song from Shizuoka Prefecture — no identifiable rights holder)
